final_rest.label: Final rest
final_rest.note: Bag followed from first contact until it stopped; rest = median of the stationary frames in camera-steadied pixels.

model_note: Drag-free fit misses the measured path by 16.9 px RMS; predicting the second half from the first half misses by 75.4 px RMS. The bag slows horizontally in the image (15% of its vertical acceleration). Drag and the bag moving away from the camera both cause this; one camera cannot separate them.
